## 抓取原文


> 公开版只收录上面"论断"里的原文摘句，全文请看来源链接。

The tech consultancy surveyed 3,200 CIOs globally in July.

Most CIOs said their organization was well prepared to govern AI, but 88% said adoption is still moving faster than governance.

Just under half said they are planning to expand the CIO role to oversee enterprise AI strategy and implementation.

But there is no one ideal model of AI ownership for every organization, Squeo said.

Finance gets visibility into consumption and value, and business units make local decisions within agreed guardrails."
